data.summary_en: ImageRSI improves reliability in satisfying complex text-to-image requests by freezing the generator and combining intra-task 5D verification/repair, a cross-task shared experience library, and offline judge updates: A/B-validated experiences enter the library; judge SFT+GRPO-updated, evaluated before use. MindBench (Nano Banana Pro): 52.6% Checklist Strict Accuracy (CSA).
